statement.zh: 将拉希加里称为哈拉帕文明「东部行省都城/最大城」等政治等级标签，超出已登记发掘报告的可直接核验范围，属开放诠释。
statement.en: Labeling Rakhigarhi an “eastern provincial capital” or “largest city” as a political-rank verdict goes beyond what registered excavation reports directly verify — open interpretation.
